nodes.name: BaseFragment

nodes.name: BaseFragmentInfo
nodes.summary: Identifies the origin of a fragment with tag and flags, used during fragment construction from DOM nodes or anonymous box creation.

nodes.name: Tag
nodes.summary: Identifies the DOM node and pseudo-element chain that a fragment originates from. Used for display list fragment ID generation and debugging output.

nodes.name: box_fragment.rs
nodes.summary: Defines BoxFragment, the primary fragment type for CSS box model elements, including padding/border/margin rect calculations, scrollable overflow computation, sticky positioning inset resolution, and baseline management. Also defines supporting types like SpecificLayoutInfo and BoxFragmentRareData.

nodes.name: BoxFragment
nodes.summary: The main fragment type representing a CSS box with padding, border, margin, baselines, scrollable overflow tracking, and spatial tree node association. Handles containing block offset calculations, sticky positioning, and layout-specific info for table/grid elements.

nodes.name: containing_block.rs
nodes.summary: Implements ContainingBlockManager, which tracks three containing block contexts (for non-absolute, absolute, and fixed descendants) during fragment tree traversal and resolves the correct containing block for each fragment based on its CSS position value.

nodes.name: fragment.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Fragment enum (the central fragment tree node type) with variants for LayoutRoot, Box, Float, Positioning, placeholders, Text, Image, and IFrame fragments. Also provides CollapsedBlockMargins and CollapsedMargin for margin collapse computation, and concrete fragment types for replaced and text content.

nodes.name: Fragment
nodes.summary: The central enum representing all fragment types in the fragment tree: LayoutRoot, Box, Float, Positioning, AbsoluteOrFixedPositionedPlaceholder, Text, Image, and IFrame. Exposes methods for box containment checks, scrolling, finding children, and point-hit testing.

nodes.name: fragment_tree.rs
nodes.summary: Defines FragmentTree, the top-level container for the entire fragment tree, managing root fragments, scrollable overflow, the initial containing block, and viewport scroll sensitivity. Provides methods for printing, finding box fragments, and clearing/computing scrollable overflow.

nodes.name: hoisted_shared_fragment.rs
nodes.summary: Defines HoistedSharedFragment, a shared fragment wrapper used for hoisted absolutely and fixed positioned fragments that are moved up the tree to their containing block while preserving original tree order for painting.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module file that declares and re-exports all fragment_tree submodules: base_fragment, box_fragment, containing_block, fragment, fragment_tree, hoisted_shared_fragment, and positioning_fragment.

nodes.name: positioning_fragment.rs
nodes.summary: Defines PositioningFragment, a fragment type for elements with position: relative/absolute/fixed/sticky, providing containing block offset, scrollable overflow, and printing support for positioned layout contexts.

nodes.name: PositioningFragment
nodes.summary: Fragment type for positioned elements (relative, absolute, fixed, sticky). Manages containing block offsets, scrollable overflow computation, and supports both anonymous and named fragment creation.

nodes.name: geom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines core geometric types used throughout layout: LogicalVec2 and LogicalRect for writing-mode-relative coordinates, LogicalSides and LogicalSides1D for logical box sides, SyncPhysicalRectAu as an atomically-updatable physical rectangle, and trait conversions between logical and physical coordinate spaces.

nodes.name: SyncPhysicalRectAu
nodes.summary: Thread-safe atomic physical rectangle wrapper using AtomicI32 for x, y, width, height, enabling concurrent read/write access during parallel layout.

nodes.name: layout_box_base.rs
nodes.summary: Defines LayoutBoxBase, the foundational node in the box tree that holds style, fragment storage, layout result caching, and subtree size tracking. Also defines layout result types for independent formatting contexts and same-formatting-context block layout.

nodes.name: LayoutBoxBase
nodes.summary: Core box tree node that stores style, fragment collection, inline content size cache, cached layout results, subtree size for parallelism heuristics, and parent references. Provides methods for fragment management and cache invalidation.

nodes.name: layout_impl.rs
nodes.summary: Implements LayoutThread, the main layout engine driving style application, box tree construction, fragment tree layout, display list building, and embedder communication. Also defines LayoutFactoryImpl for creating layout threads and supporting types for font metrics and registered painters.

nodes.name: LayoutThread
nodes.summary: The main layout driver that handles reflow requests: processes restyles, constructs the box tree, lays out fragments, builds display lists, manages image cache, handles scroll offsets, and communicates with the script and embedder threads.

nodes.name: layout_root.rs
nodes.summary: Defines LayoutRoot for tracking fragment tree layout roots (absolutely-positioned fragments that isolate damage from ancestors), enabling incremental fragment tree layout by converting upward Relayout damage into DescendantCollectedAsLayoutRoot damage.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Root module for the layout crate, declaring all submodules and defining shared types: ConstraintSpace for intrinsic sizing constraints, containing block variants (IndefiniteContainingBlock, ContainingBlock, DefiniteContainingBlock), ContainingBlockSize, and PropagatedBoxTreeData for ancestor-to-descendant data flow during box tree construction.

nodes.name: lists.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CSS list-style marker generation: creates ::marker pseudo-element content with appropriate counter representations and symbols for ordered and unordered lists.

nodes.name: positioned.rs
nodes.summary: Implements absolute and fixed positioning layout: manages AbsolutelyPositionedBox and HoistedAbsolutelyPositionedBox for hoisted positioned fragments, PositioningContext for collecting and laying out positioned descendants, and absolute axis solving with the inset-modified containing block algorithm.

nodes.name: PositioningContext
nodes.summary: Collects and manages absolutely and fixed positioned boxes within a containing block. Handles static position adjustment for hoisted fragments, parallel layout of collected children, and relative position adjustments.

nodes.name: query.rs
nodes.summary: Provides query processing utilities for the layout thread: handles requests for padding, box areas, client rects, CSS zoom, scroll areas, resolved styles, offset parents, scroll containers, text steps, character offsets, containing blocks, and effective overflow.

nodes.name: quotes.rs
nodes.summary: Contains locale-specific quotation mark data derived from ICU CLDR, providing QuotePair (opening/closing) values for over 300 language codes used by the CSS quotes property.

nodes.name: replaced.rs
nodes.summary: Implements layout for replaced elements (images, iframes, video, canvas): computes natural sizes, preferred aspect ratio, fragment creation, inline content sizes, and layout of the replaced content box with proper sizing constraints.

nodes.name: ReplacedContents

nodes.name: sizing.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CSS intrinsic sizing: ContentSizes for min/max-content, ComputeInlineContentSizes for traversing the fragment tree, Size/SizeConstraint/Sizes for resolving CSS sizing properties with percentage and auto handling, and LazySize for deferred container-size-dependent resolution.

nodes.name: ContentSizes
nodes.summary: Represents min-content and max-content sizes with operations for max, union, shrink-to-fit, and outer inline size computation.

nodes.name: style_ext.rs

nodes.name: basiclex.py
nodes.summary: PLY lexer specification for Dartmouth BASIC. Defines token rules for identifiers, REM statements, NEWLINEs, and error handling using PLY naming conventions for the BASIC example interpreter.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PLY's naming convention where t_NAME functions define token rules and t_error handles illegal characters.

nodes.name: basiclog.py
nodes.summary: Logging-enabled variant of the BASIC interpreter entry point. Configures Python logging for PLY parser debug output, writing parse trace information to a file.

nodes.name: basinterp.py
nodes.summary: Full BASIC interpreter runtime implementing statement execution for Dartmouth BASIC programs. The BasicInterpreter class handles variable assignment, arithmetic expressions, control flow (FOR/NEXT, IF/GOTO), subroutines (GOSUB/RETURN), array operations (DIM), and built-in math functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements recursive expression evaluation via self.eval() dispatching on parse tree nodes, mirroring the grammar production rules.

nodes.name: basparse.py
nodes.summary: PLY parser grammar specification for Dartmouth BASIC. Defines production rules for all BASIC statements (LET, PRINT, IF, FOR, GOTO, GOSUB, DIM, READ, DATA, REM, DEF, END, STOP), expressions with binary/unary operators, and variable references with array subscript support.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PLY yacc conventions where p_NAME functions define grammar production rules with documentation strings specifying the grammar.

nodes.name: GardenSnake.py

nodes.languageNotes: Implements indentation-sensitive lexing via INDENT/DEDENT token generation, similar to Python's own tokenizer, and compiles the AST to Python code objects using the compiler module.

nodes.name: ylex.py

nodes.languageNotes: Demonstrates PLY lexer states to switch between normal tokenization and C code block tokenization within YACC specifications.

nodes.name: yparse.py
nodes.summary: PLY parser grammar for converting YACC specification files into PLY-compatible Python code. Parses YACC definitions sections (tokens, types, precedence, union) and grammar rules, emitting equivalent PLY parser function definitions with embedded action code.
nodes.languageNotes: Meta-parser that parses YACC grammar specifications and generates PLY-compatible Python parser code as output.

nodes.name: yply.py
nodes.summary: Entry point script that converts a UNIX YACC specification file into a PLY-compatible Python parser specification. Accepts an optional -nocode flag to discard embedded C code from the generated output.

nodes.summary: Struct representing an active WebDriver session with browsing context tracking, timeout configuration, input state, and user prompt handler.

nodes.name: timeout.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the TimeoutsConfiguration struct and serialization logic for WebDriver script, page load, and implicit wait timeout settings following the W3C specification.

nodes.name: user_prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Handles WebDriver user prompts (alert, confirm, prompt dialogs) with configurable prompt handler behaviors including dismiss, accept, and text input operations. Implements the unhandled prompt behavior deserialization per the W3C spec.

nodes.name: deserialize_as_timeouts_configuration
nodes.summary: Deserializes JSON timeout values into a TimeoutsConfiguration struct, supporting script, pageLoad, and implicit keys per W3C spec.

nodes.name: serialize_timeouts_configuration
nodes.summary: Serializes a TimeoutsConfiguration to a JSON object with script, pageLoad, and implicit fields.

nodes.name: TimeoutsConfiguration
nodes.summary: Struct holding WebDriver timeout values for script execution, page loading, implicit wait, and sleep interval.

nodes.name: deserialize_unhandled_prompt_behaviour
nodes.summary: Deserializes an unhandled prompt behavior configuration value into a UserPromptHandler map per W3C spec, supporting string or object formats.

nodes.name: default_unhandled_prompt_behavior
nodes.summary: Returns the default user prompt handler configuration mapping all prompt types to 'dismiss and notify'.

nodes.name: get_user_prompt_handler
nodes.summary: Retrieves the configured prompt handler action for a given prompt type from the session, with default fallback.

nodes.name: handle_dismiss_alert
nodes.summary: Handles the DismissAlert command by sending a dismiss action to the embedder for the current user prompt.

nodes.name: handle_accept_alert
nodes.summary: Handles the AcceptAlert command by sending an accept action to the embedder for the current user prompt.

nodes.name: handle_get_alert_text
nodes.summary: Handles the GetAlertText command by retrieving the text of the current user prompt from the embedder.

nodes.name: handle_send_alert_text
nodes.summary: Handles the SendAlertText command by sending text input to the current user prompt with validation.

nodes.name: handle_any_user_prompts
nodes.summary: Checks for any pending user prompts and returns an error if present, used as a pre-condition guard for blocking commands.

nodes.name: PromptHandlerConfiguration
nodes.summary: Struct pairing a WebDriverUserPromptAction with a notify flag, representing a configured prompt handler entry.

nodes.name: ast.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the XPath abstract syntax tree (AST) data structures including expression types, binary operators, path expressions, XPath axes, node tests, kind tests, literals, and core function identifiers used across the XPath evaluation system.

nodes.name: Expression
nodes.summary: Core XPath expression AST enum with variants for binary operations, path expressions, location steps, filters, literals, variables, context items, and function calls.

nodes.name: BinaryOperator
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all XPath binary operators including boolean (or/and), set union, equality, relational, and arithmetic operators.

nodes.name: PathExpression
nodes.summary: XPath path expression consisting of an absolute/relative flag, an implicit descendant-or-self step indicator, and a sequence of location steps.

nodes.name: Axis
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all XPath axes including child, descendant, attribute, self, descendant-or-self, following-sibling, following, namespace, parent, ancestor, preceding-sibling, preceding, and ancestor-or-self.

nodes.name: CoreFunction
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all XPath 1.0 core functions including string, numeric, boolean, and node-set functions with associated argument expressions.

nodes.name: context.rs
nodes.summary: Defines evaluation context structures for XPath processing, including the root evaluation context with a context node and predicate-specific context tracking position and size within a predicate.

nodes.name: eval.rs
nodes.summary: Implements XPath expression evaluation logic including binary operations, path expressions with steps and axes, node test filtering, predicate application, and recursive descent through parsed AST nodes.

nodes.name: try_extract_nodeset
nodes.summary: Attempts to extract a NodeSet from a Value, returning an error if the value is not a nodeset.

nodes.name: Expression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Dispatches evaluation of an XPath Expression by matching its variant, handling binary operators, path expressions, location steps, filters, literals, variable references, context items, and function calls.

nodes.name: PathExpression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a path expression by traversing steps from the context node or document root, computing the accumulated node set at each step with proper axis traversal.

nodes.name: element_name_test
nodes.summary: Compares an element's qualified name against an expected name with case-sensitive or case-insensitive comparison modes for XHTML vs HTML documents.

nodes.name: apply_node_test
nodes.summary: Applies a node test (name test or kind test) against a given DOM node to determine if it matches, handling elements, attributes, processing instructions, comments, and text nodes.

nodes.name: LocationStepExpression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a location step by gathering candidate nodes from the specified axis, filtering them through the node test and predicate list, and returning the sorted result.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Applies predicate expressions to filter a matched node set, evaluating each predicate as boolean or positional numeric per XPath semantics.

nodes.name: FilterExpression.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluates a filter expression by first evaluating the inner expression, then applying predicate filters to the result set.

nodes.name: NameTestComparisonMode
nodes.summary: Enum controlling whether element name comparisons use case-sensitive (XHTML) or case-insensitive (HTML) matching, adapting XPath for HTML documents.

nodes.name: functions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements XPath 1.0 core library functions including string manipulation (substring, concat, normalize-space, translate), node introspection (local-name, name, namespace-uri), numeric operations (sum, floor, ceiling, round), boolean logic, and the lang() function.

nodes.name: substring
nodes.summary: Extracts a substring from a source string starting at a given 1-based position with an optional length, following XPath 1.0 substring semantics with character indexing.

nodes.name: normalize_space
nodes.summary: Normalizes whitespace by trimming leading and trailing whitespace and collapsing internal runs of whitespace characters into single spaces.

nodes.name: lang_matches
nodes.summary: Determines if a context language matches or is a sublanguage of a target language per XPath lang() semantics with case-insensitive comparison.

nodes.name: translate
nodes.summary: Performs character-by-character translation on an input string, replacing characters from the 'from' set with corresponding characters in the 'to' set.

nodes.name: CoreFunction.evaluate
nodes.summary: Dispatches XPath core function evaluation by matching the CoreFunction variant to the appropriate implementation, handling all 27 XPath 1.0 core functions.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the generic DOM abstraction traits (Node, Element, Attribute, Document, ProcessingInstruction, NamespaceResolver) that decouple XPath evaluation from any specific DOM implementation, plus the evaluate_parsed_xpath entry point and helper functions for name validation.

nodes.name: evaluate_parsed_xpath
nodes.summary: Entry point for evaluating a parsed XPath expression against a context node, returning a deduplicated and sorted NodeSet.

nodes.name: is_valid_start
nodes.summary: Checks if a character is valid as the start of an XML NCName per XPath tokenization rules, accepting letters, underscore, and colon.

nodes.name: is_valid_continuation
nodes.summary: Checks if a character is valid as a continuation character within an XML NCName, extending isValidStart with digits, hyphens, and dots.

nodes.name: Node
nodes.summary: Trait defining the abstract DOM node interface with methods for tree navigation (parent, children, ancestors, siblings), type checking, text content access, and document order comparison required by XPath evaluation.

nodes.name: Element
nodes.summary: Trait defining the abstract DOM element interface with methods for accessing qualified names, namespace URIs, local names, attributes, and HTML document detection.

nodes.name: Attribute
nodes.summary: Trait defining the abstract DOM attribute interface with methods for accessing prefix, namespace, and local name of an attribute node.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Error enum for XPath evaluation failures including invalid nodeset access, variable usage in unsupported contexts, invalid qualified names, and internal errors.

nodes.name: parser.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the XPath expression parser using recursive descent, transforming tokenized input into the AST representation with support for binary expressions, path expressions, step expressions with axes and node tests, function calls, and predicates.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements Pratt-style precedence climbing for binary operator parsing, and recursive descent for XPath grammar constructs.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Public entry point that creates a Parser from input string and namespace resolver, parses a single expression, and verifies no trailing input remains.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new Parser instance by tokenizing the input string and configuring the namespace resolver and HTML document flag.

nodes.name: resolve_qualified_name
nodes.summary: Resolves a namespace prefix to its full namespace URI using the registered namespace resolver for qualified name construction.

nodes.name: parse_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a top-level XPath expression with operator precedence using the Pratt parsing approach, handling negation and function call prefixes.

nodes.name: parse_union_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a union expression combining two path expressions with the | operator.

nodes.name: parse_path_expression
nodes.summary: Parses an absolute or relative path expression consisting of slash-separated location steps, handling both / and // shorthand.

nodes.name: parse_filter_or_step_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a primary expression including parenthesized expressions, function calls, numeric and string literals, variable references, and location steps.

nodes.name: parse_step_expression
nodes.summary: Parses a full location step including optional axis specifier, node test (name test or kind test with arguments), and predicate list.

nodes.name: parse_node_test
nodes.summary: Parses a node test including kind tests (comment, text, processing-instruction, node) with optional PI target argument, and wildcard name tests.

nodes.name: parse_predicates
nodes.summary: Parses a sequence of predicate expressions enclosed in brackets used to filter node sets.

nodes.name: parse_function_call
nodes.summary: Parses a function call expression by matching the function name against known XPath 1.0 core functions, validating argument counts, and constructing the appropriate CoreFunction variant.

nodes.name: create_binary_expression
nodes.summary: Constructs a binary expression node from left and right operands and an operator, wrapping the left operand in a negation node when the operator indicates subtraction.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Comprehensive error enum for XPath parsing failures covering tokenization errors, unknown functions, argument count mismatches, missing delimiters, and namespace resolution failures.

nodes.name: tokenizer.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the XPath expression tokenizer that converts raw XPath string input into typed token streams, handling NCName parsing, operator recognition, string and numeric literals, axis identifiers, and whitespace handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-pass tokenization with operator context tracking to disambiguate '-' between subtraction and name characters.

nodes.name: consume_ncname
nodes.summary: Consumes an XML NCName from the remaining input using XPath name validation rules, optionally allowing wildcards, and returns the consumed segment and remainder.

nodes.name: consume_single_token
nodes.summary: Main token dispatch that consumes the next single token from input, handling variable references, qualified names, operators, axes, punctuation, and character-based tokens with operator context awareness.

nodes.name: consume_numeric_literal
nodes.summary: Parses a numeric literal (integer or decimal) from the remaining input, handling digit sequences and optional decimal points with fallback to zero on parse failure.

nodes.name: match_operator_name
nodes.summary: Matches a name string against known XPath operator names (and, or, mod, div) for contextual operator recognition during tokenization.

nodes.name: precedence
nodes.summary: Returns the operator precedence level for an OperatorToken, used by the parser's Pratt-style expression parsing to determine binding strength.

nodes.name: is_start_of_location_step
nodes.summary: Determines if the current token position starts a location step, distinguishing path expressions from arithmetic division by examining surrounding context.

nodes.name: followed_by_operator
nodes.summary: Checks if the current token is followed by an operator in the input to disambiguate the hyphen-minus character as subtraction versus a name character.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Main tokenization entry point that converts an XPath string input into a vector of tokens, tracking operator context for correct token classification between expressions.

nodes.name: Error
nodes.summary: Error enum for tokenizer failures including invalid variable references, invalid NCNames, unterminated string literals, and illegal characters.

nodes.name: OperatorToken
nodes.summary: Enum of all XPath operator types including and, or, multiply, modulo, divide, add, subtract, comparison, and equality operators.

nodes.name: Token
nodes.summary: Comprehensive enum of all XPath token types including variable references, qualified names, operators, literals, axis identifiers, punctuation, and node type tests.

nodes.name: value.rs
nodes.summary: Implements XPath runtime value types including the Value enum (Boolean, Number, String, NodeSet) and NodeSet collection with document-order sorting, deduplication, type conversion methods, and equality comparison logic per XPath 1.0 semantics.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements XPath equality comparison with heterogeneous type promotion (boolean, number, string, nodeset) and XPath-specific numeric conversion with NaN/Infinity handling.

nodes.name: deduplicate
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate nodes from the NodeSet using opaque node identifiers, preserving the first occurrence of each unique node.

nodes.name: parse_number_from_string
nodes.summary: Parses a trimmed string as a floating-point number, returning NaN for unparseable input per XPath number() semantics.

nodes.name: eq
nodes.summary: Performs XPath value equality comparison across different types (boolean, number, string, nodeset) following XPath 1.0 comparison rules with type promotion.

nodes.name: convert_to_boolean
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to boolean per XPath rules: false for empty nodeset, zero or NaN number, and empty string; true for all other values.

nodes.name: convert_to_number
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to a number per XPath rules: true becomes 1, false becomes 0, strings are parsed, nodesets use the first node's string value then parse.

nodes.name: convert_to_string
nodes.summary: Converts a Value to a string per XPath rules: boolean to true/false, number with Infinity/NaN/zero formatting, node set to first node's text content, string returns itself.

nodes.name: backend.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the GenericDrawTarget trait and Convert trait that form the abstract drawing interface for all canvas backends, with method signatures derived from Servo's legacy Azure backend.

nodes.name: GenericDrawTarget
nodes.summary: Abstract trait defining the complete drawing surface API including fill, stroke, text rendering, clipping, shadows, and snapshot operations. Implemented by both GPU (Vello) and CPU (VelloCPU) backends.

nodes.name: Convert
nodes.summary: Conversion trait implemented by multiple types across the canvas module to convert between Servo's internal canvas types and peniko/vello rendering types.

nodes.name: canvas_data.rs
nodes.summary: Core canvas drawing data and operations layer that manages a draw target, provides all drawing primitives (rect, path, text, image, shadows, clipping), and handles image key management with the paint API.

nodes.name: CanvasData
nodes.summary: Core data structure holding a draw target, paint API reference, and optional image key. Acts as the central state holder for all canvas drawing operations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new CanvasData with a draw target sized to the given dimensions, ensuring minimum image dimensions.

nodes.name: set_image_key
nodes.summary: Replaces the image key associated with this canvas, registering the new image with the paint API and removing the old one.

nodes.name: draw_image
nodes.summary: Draws a snapshot image onto the canvas with optional source/dest rect clipping, smoothing, shadow effects, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Fills text at the specified bounds using the given fill/stroke style, optional shadow, composition mode, and transform.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Strokes text outlines using the specified style and line options, with shadow, composition, and transform support.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangular area with optional shadow effects, composition blending, and transform. Handles zero-size gradient edge cases.

nodes.name: clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular area by delegating to the underlying draw target's clear_rect method.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangular outline with line options, optional shadow effects, composition blending, and transform.

nodes.name: fill_path
nodes.summary: Fills a path using the specified fill rule and style, with shadow, composition, and transform support.

nodes.name: stroke_path
nodes.summary: Strokes a path using the specified style, line options, shadow, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: clip_path
nodes.summary: Pushes a path-based clip region onto the draw target's clip stack.

nodes.name: recreate
nodes.summary: Recreates the underlying draw target with a new size, preserving the paint API and re-applying image rendering settings.

nodes.name: update_image_rendering
nodes.summary: Updates the image rendered by the paint API from the current draw target state, keyed by the canvas epoch for synchronization.

nodes.name: put_image_data
nodes.summary: Writes raw image data into the draw target by creating a temporary surface and copying it into place.

nodes.name: read_pixels
nodes.summary: Reads pixel data from the draw target within a specified rectangle, returning a snapshot with proper bounds checking.

nodes.name: pop_clips
nodes.summary: Pops a specified number of clip regions from the draw target's clip stack.

nodes.name: write_image
nodes.summary: Helper function that draws a snapshot onto a draw target with smoothing, composition, and optional shadow effects, managing source surface creation and image placement.

nodes.name: canvas_paint_thread.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Canvas paint thread that manages multiple canvas instances, processes commands from the constellation, and dispatches drawing operations to the appropriate backend (Vello GPU or Vello CPU).

nodes.name: CanvasPaintThread
nodes.summary: Main paint thread struct holding a map of active canvases, the next canvas ID counter, and the paint API reference. Spawns a dedicated OS thread for canvas message processing.

nodes.name: Canvas
nodes.summary: Enum dispatching drawing operations to either the Vello GPU backend or the Vello CPU backend, wrapping a CanvasData instance for each variant.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Spawns the canvas paint thread, setting up message receivers for canvas commands and constellation-level messages (create/exit), then enters the message loop.

nodes.name: create_canvas
nodes.summary: Creates a new Canvas instance with the specified size, inserts it into the canvas map, and returns the assigned CanvasId.

nodes.name: process_command
nodes.summary: Main command dispatcher that processes all canvas operations (resize, remove, set image key, fill/stroke text/rect/path, clip, draw image, read/write pixels) by delegating to the target canvas's methods.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new Canvas instance selecting the Vello or VelloCPU backend based on the dom_canvas_backend preference.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Dispatches stroke text operation to the active backend's CanvasData with shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Dispatches fill text operation to the active backend's CanvasData with shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Dispatches fill rect operation to the active backend's CanvasData with style, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Dispatches stroke rect operation to the active backend's CanvasData with line options, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: fill_path
nodes.summary: Dispatches fill path operation to the active backend's CanvasData with fill rule, style, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: stroke_path
nodes.summary: Dispatches stroke path operation to the active backend's CanvasData with line options, style, shadow, composition, and transform parameters.

nodes.name: draw_image
nodes.summary: Dispatches draw image operation to the active backend's CanvasData with source/dest rects, smoothing, shadow, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the canvas component that declares all submodules (backend, canvas_data, canvas_paint_thread, peniko_conversions, vello_backend, vello_cpu_backend) and exposes the public canvas_data and canvas_paint_thread modules.

nodes.name: peniko_conversions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the Convert trait across multiple types to translate Servo's canvas internal types (colors, gradients, line options, brushes, images) into peniko and kurbo equivalents used by the Vello rendering pipeline.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Implements Convert for 16 different type pairs including FontData, Color, CompositionStyle, LineOptions, FillOrStrokeStyle, ColorStops, and snapshot-to-image conversions, bridging Servo canvas types to peniko rendering types.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust trait implementation with multiple impl blocks for different source/target type pairs, all named convert via method dispatch.

nodes.name: vello_backend.rs
nodes.summary: GPU-accelerated canvas drawing backend using the Vello renderer with wgpu. Implements GenericDrawTarget with scene graph composition, texture-based rendering, font caching, and GPU readback for snapshots.

nodes.name: VelloDrawTarget
nodes.summary: GPU-backed draw target using Vello's scene graph renderer with wgpu. Manages device resources, render textures, buffer readback, and provides the full drawing API for canvas operations.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Enum tracking the render state machine transitions: Drawing, RenderedToTexture, and RenderedToBuffer, ensuring proper resource lifecycle for GPU operations.

nodes.name: new_with_renderer
nodes.summary: Constructs a VelloDrawTarget from an existing wgpu device, queue, and renderer, setting up render textures, buffers, and default scene state.

nodes.name: with_composition
nodes.summary: Wraps a drawing operation in a scene layer that applies composition or blending effects via push/pop layer on the Vello scene.

nodes.name: ignore_clips
nodes.summary: Temporarily removes clip layers before executing a function, then restores them, used for full-canvas operations like clear and copy.

nodes.name: is_viewport_cleared
nodes.summary: Checks whether a clear rect with transform covers the full viewport by testing against clip bounds.

nodes.name: ensure_drawing
nodes.summary: Transitions the state to Drawing and initializes the scene with a transparent clear fill, ensuring the draw target is ready for new operations.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a fully initialized VelloDrawTarget by discovering a wgpu device, creating a renderer, and setting up all GPU resources with fallback backend selection.

nodes.name: clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular region by either resetting the entire scene (full viewport) or drawing a solid fill rect with clear composition.

nodes.name: copy_surface
nodes.summary: Copies a surface (image buffer) to the draw target at a specified destination with optional source rect, handling alpha premultiplication and transform.

nodes.name: draw_surface
nodes.summary: Draws a surface onto the canvas with composition blending, image filter, and transform, creating a peniko image from the source data.

nodes.name: draw_surface_with_shadow
nodes.summary: Stub implementation for drawing a surface with shadow effects - currently panics as shadow rendering is not yet supported in the Vello backend.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Fills a path on the scene graph with the given style and composition, converting fill rules and transforms to peniko types.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Fills text glyphs onto the scene graph by looking up fonts from a thread-local cache, converting font data to peniko, and drawing glyphs with the specified brush.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle on the scene graph using the converted brush style with composition and transform.

nodes.name: push_clip_rect
nodes.summary: Pushes a rectangular clip region by creating a path from the rect and delegating to push_clip with identity transform.

nodes.name: stroke
nodes.summary: Strokes a path on the scene graph with line options, brush style, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Strokes text glyphs on the scene graph with line options, font cache lookup, and brush style, converting font data to peniko format.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangle outline on the scene graph with line options, brush, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: image_descriptor_and_serializable_data
nodes.summary: Reads back the rendered buffer via GPU map_read and produces an image descriptor with serializable pixel data for transfer to the compositor.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures the current rendered state by mapping the GPU buffer and converting it into a Snapshot, removing row padding for the unpadded pixel data.

nodes.name: render_to_texture
nodes.summary: Renders the Vello scene graph to a GPU texture via wgpu, applying antialiasing and resetting the scene for subsequent drawing operations.

nodes.name: render_to_buffer
nodes.summary: Renders the scene to a GPU texture then copies the texture to a staging buffer for CPU readback, coordinating the GPU copy and queue submission.

nodes.name: map_read
nodes.summary: Maps the GPU staging buffer for reading, using oneshot channel signaling to synchronize the async map_async operation, then runs a provided closure on the mapped range.

nodes.name: vello_cpu_backend.rs
nodes.summary: CPU-based canvas drawing backend using the vello_cpu rasterizer. Implements GenericDrawTarget with software rendering, pixmap management, font caching, and snapshot generation for systems without GPU support.

nodes.name: VelloCPUDrawTarget
nodes.summary: CPU-powered draw target using vello_cpu's software renderer with pixmap backing. Provides the full GenericDrawTarget API through CPU-based scene composition and rasterization.

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Enum tracking render state: Drawing or Rendered, ensuring correct resource lifecycle for CPU rasterization.

nodes.name: with_composition
nodes.summary: Wraps a drawing operation in a blend layer using vello_cpu's push/pop layer mechanism for composition and blending effects.

nodes.name: ignore_clips
nodes.summary: Temporarily removes clip layers for full-canvas operations by saving/restoring the clip stack around a function call.

nodes.name: ensure_drawing
nodes.summary: Transitions state to Drawing, clears the pixmap with a transparent fill, and prepares the CPU render context for new operations.

nodes.name: pixmap
nodes.summary: Renders the current CPU scene to the pixmap, flushes pending operations, then returns a byte slice of the rendered pixel data.

nodes.name: is_viewport_cleared
nodes.summary: Checks whether a clear rect covers the full viewport by testing against clip bounds, using bezier path bounding boxes for clip intersection.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new VelloCPUDrawTarget with a sized pixmap, CPU render context, and resource manager.

nodes.name: clear_rect
nodes.summary: Clears a rectangular region by resetting the scene for full viewport or drawing a filled clip path with clear blending.

nodes.name: copy_surface
nodes.summary: Copies a surface to the draw target using CPU pixel operations with transform and image source setup via vello_cpu.

nodes.name: draw_surface
nodes.summary: Draws a surface onto the canvas with alpha premultiplication, composition, paint transform, and image filtering via vello_cpu.

nodes.name: draw_surface_with_shadow
nodes.summary: Stub implementation for drawing surfaces with shadow - currently panics as shadow rendering is not yet supported in the CPU backend.

nodes.name: fill
nodes.summary: Fills a path on the CPU render context with fill rule, brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: fill_text
nodes.summary: Fills text glyphs using vello_cpu's glyph_run API with font cache lookup, brush paint, composition effects, and transform.

nodes.name: fill_rect
nodes.summary: Fills a rectangle on the CPU render context with brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: push_clip_rect
nodes.summary: Pushes a rectangular clip by creating a path from the rect and delegating to push_clip with identity transform.

nodes.name: stroke
nodes.summary: Strokes a path on the CPU render context with line options, brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: stroke_text
nodes.summary: Strokes text glyphs using vello_cpu's glyph_run with stroke API, font cache, brush paint, line options, composition, and transform.

nodes.name: stroke_rect
nodes.summary: Strokes a rectangle outline on the CPU render context with line options, brush paint, transform, and composition.

nodes.name: image_descriptor_and_serializable_data
nodes.summary: Produces an image descriptor and serializable pixel data from the rendered pixmap for transfer to the compositor.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Captures the current rendered pixmap as a Snapshot with proper size and pixel data.

nodes.name: snapshot_as_pixmap
nodes.summary: Converts a pixel Snapshot into a vello_cpu Pixmap by applying alpha premultiplication and casting pixel data.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Implements Convert for FillOrStrokeStyle to vello_cpu PaintType, handling solid colors, linear/radial gradients, and image brushes.

nodes.name: paint
nodes.summary: Converts a FillOrStrokeStyle with alpha multiplier to a vello_cpu PaintType, handling alpha blending for solid colors, gradients, and images.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel file that publicly re-exports all submodules in the security directory: csp, csppolicyviolationreport, cspviolationreporttask, sanitizer, securitypolicyviolationevent, and xframeoptions.

nodes.name: csp.rs
nodes.summary: Content Security Policy (CSP) enforcement logic including navigation request blocking, inline script/style evaluation, trusted types enforcement, base URI restriction, and CSP violation reporting.

nodes.name: csppolicyviolationreport.rs
nodes.summary: Data structures and builders for CSP violation reports, including SecurityPolicyViolationReport, CSPReportUriViolationReportBody, CSPReportUriViolationReport, and the CSPViolationReportBuilder with serialization support.

nodes.name: cspviolationreporttask.rs
nodes.summary: CSP violation report task that fires SecurityPolicyViolationEvent, serializes violations to JSON, and posts them to report-uri endpoints via fetch.

nodes.name: sanitizer.rs
nodes.summary: HTML Sanitizer API implementation providing DOM node sanitization with configurable element allow/remove lists, attribute filtering, processing instruction handling, and built-in safe configurations.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the W3C Sanitizer API specification with extensive use of enums for element/attribute representations and recursive tree traversal for sanitization.

nodes.name: securitypolicyviolationevent.rs
nodes.summary: DOM SecurityPolicyViolationEvent implementation providing the event type dispatched when a CSP violation occurs, with properties for document URI, referrer, blocked URI, directives, and disposition.

nodes.name: xframeoptions.rs
nodes.summary: X-Frame-Options header enforcement for navigation responses, preventing clickjacking by checking frame ancestry and DENY/SAMEORIGIN directives.

nodes.name: CspReporting
nodes.summary: Core CSP enforcement trait with methods for evaluating JavaScript/WASM execution, navigation requests, inline behaviors, trusted types, and base URI restrictions.

nodes.name: SourcePosition

nodes.name: load_document
nodes.summary: Coordinates document loading by determining content type and dispatching to the appropriate handler (HTML, XML, text, media, JSON).

nodes.name: load_html_document
nodes.summary: Initiates HTML document parsing from network data through the parser pipeline.

nodes.name: load_xml_document
nodes.summary: Initiates XML document parsing from network data.

nodes.name: load_text_document
nodes.summary: Loads a plain text document by wrapping it in HTML with <pre> tags.

nodes.name: load_media_document
nodes.summary: Creates an HTML document embedding a media element for media types like images, video, and audio.

nodes.name: process_response
nodes.summary: Handles the initial network response, determining content type, creating the parser, and beginning document loading.

nodes.name: insert_an_element_at_the_adjusted_insertion_location
nodes.summary: Implements the HTML Standard algorithm for inserting an element at the adjusted insertion location during tree construction.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Inserts a node into the DOM tree at a given position relative to a reference child, handling parser-inserted elements and custom element reactions.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Prefetch tokenizer wrapper that delegates to an html5ever HtmlTokenizer for scanning tokens.

nodes.name: PrefetchSink
nodes.summary: Sink that processes HTML tokens during prefetch scanning, identifying resource URLs and initiating speculative fetches for scripts, stylesheets, images, and fonts.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new prefetch tokenizer, initializing resource fetching context from the document's security and browsing state.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input to the inner prefetch tokenizer for scanning.

nodes.name: process_token
nodes.summary: Processes individual HTML tokens to identify external resources, extracting URLs, CORS settings, integrity metadata, and initiating speculative fetch requests for scripts and other resources.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Synchronous XML tokenizer wrapper that delegates to xml5's XmlTokenizer and XmlTreeBuilder.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new synchronous XML tokenizer, initializing the xml5 tokenizer and tree builder.

nodes.name: feed
nodes.summary: Feeds input to the XML tokenizer and processes results including script handles and encoding indicators.

nodes.name: end
nodes.summary: Signals end of input to the XML tokenizer.

nodes.name: url
nodes.summary: Returns the URL of the XML document being parsed.

nodes.name: get_current_line
nodes.summary: Returns the current line number from the XML parser.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Trusted Types DOM implementation, declaring and re-exporting all five trusted type submodules: TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, TrustedScriptURL, TrustedTypePolicy, and TrustedTypePolicyFactory.

nodes.name: trustedhtml.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedHTML DOM type, a W3C Trusted Types wrapper for HTML strings that prevents cross-site scripting by ensuring HTML content originates from a trusted policy.

nodes.name: trustedscript.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedScript DOM type, a W3C Trusted Types wrapper for JavaScript code strings with compilation validation against Content Security Policy (CSP) restrictions.

nodes.name: trustedscripturl.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the TrustedScriptURL DOM type, a W3C Trusted Types wrapper for script URL strings used in src attributes of script-like elements.

nodes.name: trustedtypepolicy.rs
nodes.summary: Implements TrustedTypePolicy and the TrustedType enum, defining createHTML, createScript, and createScriptURL callback policies that sanitize or transform untrusted inputs into trusted types.

nodes.name: trustedtypepolicyfactory.rs
nodes.summary: Implements TrustedTypePolicyFactory, the central registry for named and default trusted type policies, providing CSP compliance checks, sink type queries, attribute/property type resolution, and trusted type string extraction.

nodes.name: TrustedHTML
nodes.summary: DOM wrapper for trusted HTML strings, implementing the W3C TrustedHTML interface with data access, stringification, JSON serialization, and type-safe conversion from user input.

nodes.name: TrustedScript
nodes.summary: DOM wrapper for trusted JavaScript code strings, implementing the W3C TrustedScript interface with CSP compilation validation and trusted type compliance checking.

nodes.name: TrustedScriptURL
nodes.summary: DOM wrapper for trusted script URL strings, implementing the W3C TrustedScriptURL interface with data access and trusted type compliance.

nodes.name: TrustedTypePolicy
nodes.summary: Defines a named trusted type policy with createHTML, createScript, and createScriptURL callback functions that transform untrusted inputs into trusted type objects.

nodes.name: TrustedType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of the three trusted type variants (TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, TrustedScriptURL) used for IDL type matching in policy enforcement.

nodes.name: TrustedTypePolicyFactory
nodes.summary: Central factory object that creates and manages trusted type policies, resolves sink types for attributes and properties, validates CSP restrictions, and extracts trusted type compliant strings.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedHTML DOM object, wrapping the data string in a DOM reflector with the global context.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Validates and extracts a trusted HTML string from input, delegating to TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement when the input is a plain string.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Accessor that returns the underlying trusted HTML string data.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Converts a TrustedHTMLOrString union type into a DOMString by either extracting the trusted HTML data or returning the plain string.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedScript DOM object, wrapping the data string in a DOM reflector.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Validates and extracts a trusted script string from input, delegating to TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement when the input is a plain string.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Accessor that returns the underlying trusted script string data.

nodes.name: can_compile_string_with_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Determines whether a string can be compiled as JavaScript under Trusted Types and CSP enforcement, validating the string is a TrustedScript or falls back to the default policy.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedScriptURL DOM object, wrapping the URL string in a DOM reflector.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Validates and extracts a trusted script URL string from input, delegating to TrustedTypePolicyFactory for policy enforcement when the input is a plain string.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Accessor that returns the underlying trusted script URL string data.

nodes.name: matches_idl_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given IDL trusted type string matches one of the supported variants: TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, or TrustedScriptURL.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedTypePolicy DOM object with the given name and policy callback options.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_policy_value
nodes.summary: Retrieves a trusted type value by invoking the appropriate policy callback (createHTML, createScript, or createScriptURL) and validates the result.

nodes.name: create_trusted_type
nodes.summary: Creates a trusted type object by calling the policy's callback and wrapping the returned value in the appropriate trusted type DOM wrapper.

nodes.name: CreateHTML
nodes.summary: Creates a TrustedHTML object by invoking the policy's createHTML callback, or by directly wrapping the input string.

nodes.name: CreateScript
nodes.summary: Creates a TrustedScript object by invoking the policy's createScript callback, or by directly wrapping the input string.

nodes.name: CreateScriptURL
nodes.summary: Creates a TrustedScriptURL object by invoking the policy's createScriptURL callback, or by directly wrapping the input string.

nodes.name: convert
nodes.summary: Converts a TrustedTypesUnion value into a DOMString by extracting the inner data from TrustedHTML, TrustedScript, or TrustedScriptURL variants.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new TrustedTypePolicyFactory DOM object with empty default policy and policy name tracking.

nodes.name: create_trusted_type_policy
nodes.summary: Creates a named TrustedTypePolicy, checking CSP allowlists for trusted type policy creation and enforcing the single-default-policy constraint.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_data_for_attribute
nodes.summary: Resolves the expected trusted type for a given attribute on a specific element, covering event handlers, iframe srcdoc, script src, and SVG script href attributes.

nodes.name: get_trusted_types_compliant_attribute_value
nodes.summary: Validates and returns a trusted-type-compliant attribute value, checking the attribute's expected type and falling back to the factory's trusted type string extraction.

nodes.name: process_value_with_default_policy
nodes.summary: Processes a value through the default policy's callbacks, converting JS values to trusted type parameters and extracting the resulting compliant string.

nodes.name: get_trusted_type_compliant_string
nodes.summary: Core function for extracting a trusted-type-compliant string from an input value, checking CSP sink requirements, applying the default policy, and enforcing type mismatch violations.

nodes.name: is_trusted_script
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given JS value is a TrustedScript object by attempting to downcast via DOM reflector.

nodes.name: GetAttributeType
nodes.summary: Resolves the expected Trusted Type for an element attribute by normalizing namespaces and delegating to get_trusted_type_data_for_attribute.

nodes.name: GetPropertyType
nodes.summary: Resolves the expected Trusted Type for a DOM element property, covering innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, and script text content properties across HTML, SVG, and MathML namespaces.

nodes.name: embedder_controls.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the request and response types for embedder-level UI controls including select elements, file pickers, context menus, input methods, and simple dialogs such as alert/confirm/prompt.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlId
nodes.summary: Identifies a specific embedder UI control instance by webview, pipeline, and epoch index.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlRequest
nodes.summary: Enum of requests from the engine to the embedder to display a UI control: select element, color picker, file picker, input method, or context menu.

nodes.name: SelectElementOption
nodes.summary: Represents a single option in a select element with an id, label, and disabled state.

nodes.name: SelectElementOptionOrOptgroup
nodes.summary: Enum representing either a select option or an optgroup containing nested options.

nodes.name: ContextMenuRequest
nodes.summary: Request to present a context menu triggered by right-clicking on web content.

nodes.name: ContextMenuItem
nodes.summary: Enum representing either a labeled context menu item with an action, or a separator.

nodes.name: ContextMenuAction
nodes.summary: Enum of context-sensitive actions available in a context menu, including navigation, clipboard, and link/image operations.

nodes.name: ContextMenuElementInformation
nodes.summary: Bitflag-based metadata about the element a context menu was activated for, indicating link, image, editable text, and selection flags.

nodes.name: InputMethodRequest
nodes.summary: Request to present an IME when an editable text element is focused, with text content and cursor position.

nodes.name: FilePickerRequest
nodes.summary: Request to display a file picker dialog with origin, current paths, filter patterns, and multiselect configuration.

nodes.name: SelectElementRequest
nodes.summary: Request to display a select element control with options, preselected indices, and multiselect configuration.

nodes.name: EmbedderControlResponse
nodes.summary: Response from the embedder to an EmbedderControlRequest, carrying the result of select, color, file, or context menu interactions.

nodes.name: SelectedFile
nodes.summary: Represents a file selected by the user in a file picker, with UUID, filename, modification time, size, and MIME type string.

nodes.name: SimpleDialogRequest
nodes.summary: Enum representing alert, confirm, or prompt dialog requests with embedded control IDs and response senders.

nodes.name: AlertResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for alert dialogs with a single Ok variant.

nodes.name: ConfirmResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for confirm dialogs with Ok and Cancel variants.

nodes.name: PromptResponse
nodes.summary: Response enum for prompt dialogs with Ok carrying the input string and Cancel variants.

nodes.name: input_events.rs
nodes.summary: Defines all input event types and structures for keyboard, mouse, touch, wheel, gamepad, and IME events sent from the embedder to Servo.

nodes.name: InputEvent
nodes.summary: Top-level enum of all input events sent from the embedder to Servo: editing actions, gamepad, IME, keyboard, mouse button, mouse leave, mouse move, touch, and wheel.

nodes.name: InputEventAndId
nodes.summary: Pairs an InputEvent with its InputEventId for tracking event handling outcomes.

nodes.name: EditingActionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of editing actions that can be performed on a WebView: Copy, Cut, Paste.

nodes.name: KeyboardEvent
nodes.summary: Wraps a keyboard_types::KeyboardEvent for use in the embedder input event pipeline with constructors for various creation patterns.

nodes.name: MouseButtonEvent
nodes.summary: Represents a mouse button press or release event with action type, button, and viewport point.

nodes.name: MouseButton
nodes.summary: Enum of mouse buttons: Left, Middle, Right, Back, Forward, and Other for extended buttons.

nodes.name: MouseButtonAction
nodes.summary: Enum of mouse button actions: Down or Up.

nodes.name: MouseMoveEvent
nodes.summary: Represents a mouse move event with viewport point and a flag for compatibility events synthesized from touch input.

nodes.name: MouseLeftViewportEvent
nodes.summary: Event sent when the mouse cursor leaves the viewport, optionally due to focus moving to another iframe.

nodes.name: TouchEventType
nodes.summary: Enum of touch event types: Down, Move, Up, and Cancel.

nodes.name: TouchPointerType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing Pen and Touch as the physical input source for a touch event.

nodes.name: TouchEvent
nodes.summary: Represents a multi-touch event with event type, touch ID, viewport point, pointer type, and cancelable flag.

nodes.name: WheelMode
nodes.summary: Enum specifying the unit of wheel delta values: pixels, lines, or pages.

nodes.name: WheelDelta
nodes.summary: Three-dimensional scroll delta (x, y, z) with a mode specifying the unit of measurement.

nodes.name: WheelEvent
nodes.summary: Wraps a WheelDelta with a viewport point for scroll event processing.

nodes.name: ImeEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of IME events: Composition carrying a CompositionEvent, or Dismissed.

nodes.name: GamepadInputBounds
nodes.summary: Minimum and maximum values that can be reported for axis or button input from a gamepad.

nodes.name: GamepadSupportedHapticEffects
nodes.summary: Indicates whether a gamepad supports dual rumble and trigger rumble haptic effects.

nodes.name: GamepadEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad events: Connected, Disconnected, and Updated with axis or button update types.

nodes.name: GamepadUpdateType
nodes.summary: Enum identifying whether a gamepad update is an axis or button change, each carrying an index and value.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts an InputEvent into InputEventAndId by generating a new InputEventId.

nodes.name: point
nodes.summary: Returns the viewport point associated with an InputEvent by matching on event variants, returning None for events without a point.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a KeyboardEvent wrapping the given keyboard_types::KeyboardEvent.

nodes.name: new_without_event
nodes.summary: Creates a KeyboardEvent from individual key state components including state, key, code, location, modifiers, repeat, and composing flag.

nodes.name: from_state_and_key
nodes.summary: Creates a KeyboardEvent from just a KeyState and Key, using defaults for remaining fields.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a MouseButtonEvent from action, button, and viewport point.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a u64 value into a MouseButton enum by matching standard button indices 0-4.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a MouseButton to i16 for serialization by matching each variant to its numeric code.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a MouseMoveEvent with the given viewport point and compatibility flag set to false.

nodes.name: new_compatibility_for_touch
nodes.summary: Creates a MouseMoveEvent marked as a compatibility event synthesized from touch input.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a TouchEvent from event type, touch ID, viewport point, and pointer type, with cancelable defaulting to true.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Central module crate defining all embedder-facing types including viewport geometry, cursor management, embedder messaging, media session, permissions, web resource requests, JavaScript evaluation, notifications, and webview management.

nodes.name: WebViewPoint
nodes.summary: Describes a point in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with conversion methods.

nodes.name: WebViewRect
nodes.summary: Describes a rectangle in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with scale conversion.

nodes.name: WebViewVector
nodes.summary: Describes a 2D vector in a WebView, expressed either in device pixels or CSS page pixels with scale conversion.

nodes.name: Scroll
nodes.summary: Enum of scroll operations: delta offset, scroll to start, or scroll to end.

nodes.name: ShutdownState
nodes.summary: Tracks whether Servo is not shutting down, in progress, or has finished shutting down.

nodes.name: Cursor
nodes.summary: Large enum of all standard cursor types including resize cursors, grab, pointer, text, zoom, and more.

nodes.name: EventLoopWaker
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to implement, allowing Servo to request the main event loop be woken up for message processing.

nodes.name: GenericEmbedderProxy
nodes.summary: Generic sender paired with an event loop waker for dispatching messages to the embedder and waking its event loop.

nodes.name: RefreshDriver
nodes.summary: Trait for embedders to drive animation frame scheduling, e.g. via Vsync notifications.

nodes.name: AuthenticationResponse
nodes.summary: Credentials for HTTP authentication challenges with username and password fields.

nodes.name: AllowOrDeny
nodes.summary: Simple enum for binary allow/deny responses to permission requests.

nodes.name: RegisterOrUnregister
nodes.summary: Simple enum indicating whether a protocol handler should be registered or unregistered.

nodes.name: ProtocolHandlerUpdateRegistration
nodes.summary: Represents a request to register or unregister a custom protocol handler for a URL scheme.

nodes.name: ViewportDetails
nodes.summary: Viewport size and HiDPI scale factor for rendering WebView contents.

nodes.name: ScreenMetrics
nodes.summary: Screen size and available size in device-independent pixels for DOM Screen API usage.

nodes.name: PixelFormat
nodes.summary: Enum of pixel buffer formats: K8, KA8, RGB8, RGBA8, and BGRA8.

nodes.name: Image
nodes.summary: A raster image buffer with width, height, pixel format, and shared memory backing for pixel data.

nodes.name: ConsoleLogLevel
nodes.summary: Enum of console API message severity levels: Log, Debug, Info, Warn, Error, Trace, Dir.

nodes.name: BluetoothDeviceDescription
nodes.summary: Address and human-readable name for a discovered Bluetooth device.

nodes.name: EmbedderMsg
nodes.summary: Central enum of all messages sent from Servo to the embedder, covering 25+ message types including status, clipboard, cursor, media session, permissions, web resource interception, accessibility, and devtools.
nodes.languageNotes: Large enum with variants carrying WebViewId, GenericSender callbacks, and domain-specific payloads for bidirectional process communication.

nodes.name: MediaMetadata
nodes.summary: Media session metadata: title, artist, and album strings for media notifications.

nodes.name: MediaSessionPlaybackState
nodes.summary: Enum of media session playback states: None, Playing, Paused.

nodes.name: MediaPositionState
nodes.summary: Media playback position state with duration, playback rate, and current position.

nodes.name: MediaSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Enum of media session events: SetMetadata, PlaybackStateChange, SetPositionState.

nodes.name: PermissionFeature
nodes.summary: Enum of permission features matching the DOM PermissionName enum including geolocation, notifications, camera, microphone, bluetooth, screen wake lock, and gamepad.

nodes.name: InputMethodType
nodes.summary: Enum of input method editor types appropriate for editing HTML input fields: color, date, email, number, password, text, url, etc.

nodes.name: DualRumbleEffectParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for dual-rumble gamepad haptic effects: duration, start delay, strong and weak magnitude.

nodes.name: GamepadHapticEffectType
nodes.summary: Enum of gamepad haptic effect types, currently only DualRumble with parameters.

nodes.name: WebResourceRequest
nodes.summary: Details of a web resource request including method, headers, URL, destination, referrer, and flags for main frame and redirect status.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponseMsg
nodes.summary: Enum of messages for web resource interception: Start with response, SendBodyData, FinishLoad, CancelLoad, and DoNotIntercept.

nodes.name: WebResourceResponse
nodes.summary: HTTP response data for intercepted web resources: URL, headers, status code, and status message.

nodes.name: Theme
nodes.summary: Enum of platform theme: Light or Dark.

nodes.name: MediaSessionActionType
nodes.summary: Enum of media session action types: Play, Pause, SeekBackward, SeekForward, PreviousTrack, NextTrack, SkipAd, Stop, and SeekTo.

nodes.name: LoadStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of web page load states: Started, HeadParsed, Complete.

nodes.name: Notification
nodes.summary: Desktop notification data including title, body, tag, language, silent flag, icon/badge/image URLs with associated raster resources, and action buttons.

nodes.name: NotificationAction
nodes.summary: Action button for a desktop notification: name, title, icon URL, and icon raster resource.

nodes.name: ScreenGeometry
nodes.summary: Screen size, available size, and window rectangle in device pixels for CSSOM Screen APIs and window position queries.

nodes.name: PaintHitTestResult
nodes.summary: Result of a paint hit test containing the pipeline ID, viewport point, and external scroll ID.

nodes.name: AnimationState
nodes.summary: Enum of animation state combinations: whether animations and animation callbacks are present or absent.

nodes.name: JSValue
nodes.summary: Enum of JavaScript values that can be serialized across the process boundary: Undefined, Null, Boolean, Number, String, Element, ShadowRoot, Frame, Window, Array, Object.

nodes.name: JavaScriptErrorInfo
nodes.summary: Detailed JavaScript error information: message, filename, stack trace, line number, and column.

nodes.name: JavaScriptEvaluationResultSerializationError
nodes.summary: Error enum for failures during JavaScript result serialization: detached shadow root, stale element, unknown type, or other errors.

nodes.name: JavaScriptEvaluationError
nodes.summary: Error enum for JavaScript evaluation failures including document not found, compilation failure, evaluation failure, internal error, webview not ready, and serialization error.

nodes.name: ScreenshotCaptureError
nodes.summary: Error enum for screenshot capture failures: could not read image or webview does not exist.

nodes.name: RgbColor
nodes.summary: Simple RGB color value with red, green, and blue byte fields.

nodes.name: ScriptToEmbedderChan
nodes.summary: Wraps a GenericCallback for sending EmbedderMsg from the script thread to the embedder with event loop waking.

nodes.name: NewWebViewDetails
nodes.summary: Details for communicating a new WebView created by the embedder back to the constellation: ID, viewport details, and user content manager ID.

nodes.name: UrlRequest
nodes.summary: A customizable URL load request with URL and configurable HTTP headers.

nodes.name: WakeLockType
nodes.summary: Enum of wake lock types, currently only Screen.

nodes.name: WakeLockDelegate
nodes.summary: Trait for platform-specific wake lock support to prevent the screen from sleeping while a wake lock is held.

nodes.name: as_device_point
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewPoint to DevicePoint by applying the CSS-to-device-pixel scale factor.

nodes.name: as_device_rect
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewRect to DeviceRect by applying the CSS-to-device-pixel scale factor.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a LayoutRect to a WebViewRect by constructing a Box2D from CSSPixel points.

nodes.name: as_device_vector
nodes.summary: Converts a WebViewVector to DeviceVector2D by applying the CSS-to-device-pixel scale factor.

nodes.name: send
nodes.summary: Sends a message through the proxy channel and wakes the embedder event loop, logging warnings on failure.

nodes.name: clone
nodes.summary: Clones the GenericEmbedderProxy by cloning its sender and event loop waker.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new Image with width, height, shared memory data, byte range, and pixel format.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a ConsoleLogLevel to the equivalent log::Level for integration with the Rust logging facade.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates MediaMetadata with the given title and empty artist and album strings.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a MediaPositionState from duration, playback rate, and position values.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a new WebResourceResponse with default empty headers, OK status, and OK status message.

nodes.name: from
nodes.summary: Converts a Theme enum to a PrefersColorScheme for CSS media query evaluation.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a ScriptToEmbedderChan wrapping a GenericCallback that forwards EmbedderMsg and wakes the event loop on arrival.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a UrlRequest from a URL with an empty header map.

nodes.name: resources.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Resource enum for embedder-bundled assets and the ResourceReaderMethods trait with a static registration mechanism via inventory crate.

nodes.name: Resource
nodes.summary: Enum of all bundled resources: bluetooth blocklist, domain list, HSTS preload, error pages, icons, debugger JS, and JSON viewer HTML.

nodes.name: ResourceReaderMethods
nodes.summary: Trait that embedders implement to provide resource reading with sandbox-aware file access for content processes.

nodes.name: read_bytes
nodes.summary: Reads a named Resource and returns its contents as raw bytes via the registered resource reader.

nodes.name: read_string
nodes.summary: Reads a named Resource and returns its contents as a UTF-8 string.

nodes.name: sandbox_access_files
nodes.summary: Returns the list of files that should remain accessible after sandboxing the content process.

nodes.name: sandbox_access_files_dirs
nodes.summary: Returns the list of directories that should remain accessible after sandboxing the content process.

nodes.name: filename
nodes.summary: Returns the filename associated with each Resource variant, mapping bluetooth blocklist, error pages, icons, and other assets to their file names.

nodes.name: user_contents.rs
nodes.summary: Defines types for injecting user-provided stylesheets and scripts into web pages, with ID generation, source management, and memory accounting.

nodes.name: UserContentManagerId
nodes.summary: Opaque identifier for a user content manager with auto-incrementing atomic ID generation.

nodes.name: UserContents
nodes.summary: Container for user-injected scripts and stylesheets to be applied to web pages.

nodes.name: UserStyleSheet
nodes.summary: A user-injected stylesheet with auto-generated ID, CSS source string, and source URL.

nodes.name: UserScript
nodes.summary: A user-injected script with auto-generated ID, JavaScript source string, and optional source file path on disk.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a UserStyleSheet from a CSS source string and URL, generating a new ID.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates a UserScript from a script source string and optional source file path, generating a new ID.

nodes.name: size_of
nodes.summary: Implements MallocSizeOf for UserScript, accounting for the ID, script string, and source file path memory.

nodes.name: webdriver.rs
nodes.summary: Defines WebDriver command messages, script commands, prompt handling, frame IDs, load status types, and sender channels for remote browser automation.

nodes.name: WebDriverUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver user prompt types: Alert, BeforeUnload, Confirm, Default, File, Prompt, and FallbackDefault with string parsing.

nodes.name: WebDriverUserPromptAction
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver prompt handling actions: Accept, Dismiss, Ignore with string parsing.

nodes.name: CustomHandlersAutomationMode
nodes.summary: Enum for protocol handler automation mode: AutoAccept, AutoReject, or None.

nodes.name: NewWindowTypeHint
nodes.summary: Enum for WebDriver new-window type hints: Auto, Tab, Window.

nodes.name: WebDriverCommandMsg

nodes.name: WebDriverScriptCommand
nodes.summary: Very large enum of script-level WebDriver commands including element finding (CSS, XPath, link text, tag name, shadow DOM), cookie management, attribute/property access, scrolling, and load status tracking.

nodes.name: WebDriverFrameId
nodes.summary: Enum for identifying frames by either a short index or a DOM element string.

nodes.name: WebDriverLoadStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of WebDriver navigation load states: NavigationStart, NavigationStop, Complete, Timeout, Blocked.

nodes.name: WebDriverSenders
nodes.summary: Collection of senders for asynchronous WebDriver communication: load status senders, script evaluation interrupt sender, and pending traversal senders.

nodes.name: new_from_str
nodes.summary: Parses a string into a WebDriverUserPrompt enum matching standard WebDriver prompt type names.

nodes.name: new_from_str
nodes.summary: Parses a string into a WebDriverUserPromptAction enum matching standard WebDriver action names.

nodes.name: layout_dom.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the LayoutDomTypeBundle trait and associated type aliases that map DOM node types to their concrete layout implementations, enabling parameterization of the Layout trait over a single type bundle.

nodes.name: layout_element.rs

nodes.name: layout_node.rs
